name: Squishies
description: Manchester Toys squishies sorted by type: Dumplings, Fruit, Food, Characters, Jumbo, Sugar, Butter, Vaseline, Stretchy, NeeDoh and Christmas.
longDescription: Every squishy is sorted into its own type aisle. All squishies sell as a box of 12 – the price shown is the full box price.

name: Fruit Squishies
description: Mango, banana, peach and mixed fruit squishies. Box of 12.
longDescription: Mango, banana, peach and mixed fruit squishies. Box of 12.

name: Food Squishies
description: Burger, pizza, cookie, ice cream, peanut and soda squishies. Box of 12.
longDescription: Burger, pizza, cookie, ice cream, peanut and soda squishies. Box of 12.

name: Character & Animal Squishies
description: Stitch, Labubu, puffer balls, Smushers and animal squishies. Box of 12.
longDescription: Stitch, Labubu, puffer balls, Smushers and animal squishies. Box of 12.

name: Stretchy Squishies
description: Stretchy swirl squishy tubes. Box of 12.
longDescription: Stretchy swirl squishy tubes. Box of 12.

name: Jumbo Squishies
description: Giant and jumbo-size squishies for big squeezes.
longDescription: Oversized fruit, food, pickle, rocket and cheese squishies — the jumbo aisle of Squishies.

name: Small Squishies
description: Pocket and desk squishies. £1.50 each — minimum order 12 pieces.
longDescription: Everyday small squishies, fruit squeezes and sensory jars. Priced each at £1.50, with a minimum order of 12 pieces.

name: Sugar Squishies
description: Candy, glitter, cube-squeeze and soft-cute sugar squishies. Minimum order 12 pieces.
longDescription: Candy-shaped glitter squeezes, cube boxes, expression squares, block packs and Nice Cream-style sugar squishies. Minimum order 12 pieces.

name: Wax Squishies
description: Crispy chocolate and wax-feel squishies in clear tubs.
longDescription: Crisp Choco bars and crispy pastel balls in clear tubs — the wax aisle of Squishies.

name: Crunchy Squishies
description: Crunchy and crispy sensory squishies.
longDescription: Crunchy, crispy and crackle-feel squishies for that satisfying squeeze sound.

name: Vaseline Squishies
description: Soft Vaseline-style butter and fruit squishies.
longDescription: Vaseline butter sticks, fruit Vaseline jars and slow-rise cream squeezes.

name: Dumpling Squishies
description: Dumpling, bun and Scrunchems mega dumpling sets.
longDescription: Face dumplings, festive dumplings, 3D buns and mega rainbow dumpling packs.

name: Butter Squishies
description: Butter bricks and sticks. Priced each — small £2.50, big £4.50. Minimum order 12.
longDescription: Slow-rise butter bricks, rainbow butter and big butter sticks. Priced each (small £2.50 / big £4.50), minimum order 12 pieces.

name: Christmas Squishies
description: Real Christmas squishies from the client Christmas folder. Prices on request until confirmed.
longDescription: Merry & Bright water squishies, gingerbread and NeeDoh Christmas cubes from the client Christmas squishy stock. Display-box Taba character sets are not listed here. Advent calendars stay under Seasonal.

name: NeeDoh Squishies
description: NeeDoh Nice-Sicle, Dream Drop and assorted NeeDoh squeezes. £24 box of 12.
longDescription: Official-feel NeeDoh sensory squeezes from the Manchester Toys Telegram dump: Nice-Sicle, Dream Drop and mixed assortments. Priced as a box of 12 at £24.

name: Cars & Vehicles
description: Die-cast cars, trucks, aircraft and remote-control vehicles.
longDescription: Metal model cars, fire trucks, stunt racers, aircraft and other vehicles with a clear photo and a UK price on every card.

name: Dolls
description: Fashion dolls, baby dolls, princess dolls and doll playsets.
longDescription: Dolls you can dress, care for and take on a day out — fashion dolls, baby dolls, princess dolls, cry baby dolls and doll playsets, each with its own photo.

name: Plush & Soft Toys
description: Teddies, character plush and hug-size soft toys.
longDescription: Soft toys and plush characters — teddies, Stitch, Bluey and other hug-size friends. Labubu has its own aisle. Plush keyrings stay with the keyrings.

name: Labubu
description: Labubu plush, outfits, bags and surprise boxes.
longDescription: The Labubu aisle: plush, outfits, bags, surprise boxes and big sizes. Squishy Labubu stays with the squishies.

name: K-Pop & Collectible Figures
description: K-Pop sets, Sonny Angels and collectible figures.
longDescription: K-Pop dolls and figures, Sonny Angels, character figures and surprise figure packs. Keyrings stay in the keyring aisle.

name: Fidget & Sensory
description: Spinners, slime, pop-its and stress toys.
longDescription: Desk fidgets that are not squishies: spinners, slime, pop-its, push-pops and stress toys.

name: Light-Up Toys
description: LED toys, glow swords, lanterns and light-up wands.
longDescription: Toys picked for the light: swords, wands, lanterns, glasses and other LED play. Christmas light sets sit in Seasonal.

name: Keyrings & Bag Charms
description: Keyrings, bag charms and clip-on characters.
longDescription: Bag charms and keyrings, from soft critters to metal clips. One listing per style so the charm is easy to see.

name: Bubbles & Water Toys
description: Bubble guns, bubble cameras and splash water toys.
longDescription: Garden bubbles and water play: bubble guns, animal bubble cameras and splash balls.

name: Outdoor & Sports
description: Balls, blasters, bikes and garden sports.
longDescription: Outside play: balls, blasters, skateboards, bikes and other garden sports.

name: Building & Construction
description: Blocks, tracks and construction sets.
longDescription: Building sets, block packs and track play. Slow-rise food blocks stay with the squishies.

name: Arts, Crafts & Stationery
description: Pens, stickers, calendars and making kits.
longDescription: Stationery and making: gel pens, stickers, calendars and craft sets.

name: Role Play & Pretend Play
description: Kitchens, salons, castles and pretend-play sets.
longDescription: Pretend play: kitchens, salons, castles, doctor kits and other dress-up sets.

name: Games & Cards
description: Playing cards, table games and puzzles.
longDescription: Cards, table games and puzzles for a kitchen-table round.

name: Baby & Toddler
description: First gyms, mats and push toys for the youngest players.
longDescription: Early play: activity gyms, musical mats and first ride-ons sized for toddlers.

name: Bags & Accessories
description: Character bags, purses and small accessories.
longDescription: Bags, purses, trolleys and character accessories, listed one style at a time.

name: Party, Hats & Dress-Up
description: Party hats, masks, flags and dress-up.
longDescription: Hats, masks, flags and dress-up for parties. Halloween and Christmas pieces also appear under Seasonal.

name: Seasonal (Halloween & Christmas)
description: Halloween and Christmas toys, lights and advent calendars.
longDescription: Halloween and Christmas: masks, advent calendars, Santa toys and festive lights. Seasonal squishies stay in Squishies.

name: Home & Gifts
description: Blankets, fans, cups, bottles, frames and gift-home bits.
longDescription: Home and gift lines: bedding, blankets, towels, cups, bottles, fans, cushion covers, umbrellas and frames.
